## ECMO

### 1. [The Unknown Others of Neonatal Respiratory Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation](https://doi.org/10.1097/MAT.0000000000002822)
**ASAIO J, 2026, Journal Article** — Rose AT, Lakhani A, Conroy S, et al.
PMID: [42638325](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42638325/) · DOI: 10.1097/MAT.0000000000002822

ELSO registry study reclassifying 3,234 neonatal respiratory ECMO runs coded "Other" into 13 modern diagnostic categories.

**Practice impact:** Hypothesis-generating / registry-methodology. Argues for improved ELSO data entry.
Tag: [ ]

### 2. [Left ventricular unloading during VA-ECMO for refractory cardiogenic shock: a target trial emulation multicenter analysis](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13054-026-06213-4)
**Crit Care, 2026, Journal Article, Multicenter Study** — Dettling A, Saura O, Dilange L, et al.
PMID: [42661221](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42661221/) · DOI: 10.1186/s13054-026-06213-4

Bi-center retrospective target-trial emulation of 264 VA-ECMO patients comparing VA-ECMO alone to VA-ECMO plus early LV unloading.

**Practice impact:** Hypothesis-generating null finding. Authors frame this as evidence for a phenotype-driven approach.
Tag: [ ]

## Respiratory & ARDS

### 3. [Comparison of Efficacy Between Non-Invasive Ventilation and High-Flow Nasal Cannula Oxygen Therapy in Treating Acute Pulmonary Edema](https://doi.org/10.1002/resp.70304)
**Respirology, 2026, Journal Article** — Huang Q, Niu J, Zha S, et al.
PMID: [42644455](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42644455/) · DOI: 10.1002/resp.70304

Retrospective propensity-score-matched cohort comparing NIV and HFNC for acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema.

**Practice impact:** Hypothesis-generating / confirmatory of NIV-first practice. Retrospective database design with PSM limits causal certainty.
Tag: [ ]

## Misc

### 4. [The Association Between Obesity and ICU Duration in Pediatric Critical Asthma](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42584187/)
*Pediatr Crit Care Med, 2026, Journal Article.* PMID: 42584187

Multicenter registry analysis of obesity's association with ICU length of stay in children admitted for critical asthma. Fixture block: PMID present, no DOI link or DOI field at all.

**Practice impact:** Confirmatory large-registry signal linking obesity to prolonged pediatric asthma ICU stay; observational, cannot establish causality.
